The source VAE class gains a beta attribute (default 1, so the ELBO is unchanged) and a separate bernoulli_recon helper, so the likelihood choice is explicit. This matches Lab 1's use of beta and Bernoulli logits.
Section 3 says that the latent-diffusion compressor is a VAE-style autoencoder with a light KL penalty and an adversarial term, not a plain VAE, to agree with Rombach et al.
